programme.title: Computer Science BSc (Hons) - Undergraduate programmes
programme.degree: BSc (Hons), 4 years full-time, UCAS G400, start September 2027
programme.notes: BEng (Hons) Computer Science (G401) is the sibling degree with near-identical content.

english.quote: IELTS Academic : total 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each
english.notes: Programme entry-requirements page (2027 entry). TOEFL-iBT: 92 with 20 in each component (tests before 21 January 2026) or 4.5 with 4.0 in each (new scale, from 21 January 2026). Tests must be no more than two years old at programme start.

gpa.notes: Grades are UK/IB/country-specific offers, not a GPA: A levels 'from A*A*A* to AAB' is the range most applicants needed in recent years (indicative); SQA Highers AAAAA; international qualifications by country are in a dropdown not rendered in the readable text. Prose, kept here only.

deadline.quote: 2027 entry UCAS deadline: 13 January 2027 (6:00pm GMT) This is the deadline for all UK, EU and international applicants to non-medicine and veterinary medicine programmes.
deadline.notes: UCAS deadline for 2027 entry, explicitly including international applicants.

tuition.notes: The degree finder's fee table (study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/undergraduate-fees?programme_code=UTBSCIS, 'Estimate your tuition fees (2027-2028 entry)') and registryservices.ed.ac.uk 'Full-time fees for new students 2027-2028' render the amounts client-side: the readable text has no figure. International students pay a fixed annual fee based on the start date (quoted on the fee page).

scholarship_exists.quote: Scholarships are open to students from around the world who have medalled in international Olympiads.
scholarship_exists.notes: Listed on the University's 'International and EU students' undergraduate funding page; Olympiad medallists only; competitive. Other listed awards are subject- or country-specific (Mathematics, Veterinary, Turkey, Rosedale OSSD, asylum seekers). The study.ed.ac.uk funding page also says 'We also offer a limited number of scholarships and funding opportunities to international students.'

scholarship_international.quote: Scholarships are open to students from around the world who have medalled in international Olympiads.
scholarship_international.notes: Open worldwide, restricted to international Olympiad medallists.
